electrical_mine_rolling.name: Rolling electrical mine
electrical_mine_rolling.description: A rolling charge with a recessed luminous seam and extruded teeth made with Mesh Grammar. Proximity or a thrown-object impact detonates the charge.
electrical_mine_rolling.qfep_connection: A local face rule changes the shell while a shared spherical collider keeps its rolling behavior consistent.

electrical_mine_floor.description: Mesh Grammar charge: proximity or thrown-object impact detonates and drains Model B battery.
